entry.name: array.some
entry.digest: Test the elements of an array object for a matching condition
entry.description: Each element of an incoming array will be output sequentially. Each element can be tested and a or passed back into the right inlet of the array.some object, indicating whether the element passed the test. When iteration is complete, either a or will be output, signalling whether some elements of the array matched the testing condition.

messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Convert a list to an array.
messages.description: Convert an incoming list to an array, then process as described for themessage.

messages.name: array
messages.digest: Iterate elements and test for a condition
messages.description: In the left inlet, an incoming array will trigger the output of each element sequentially, as a series of individual messages. The element index will be output from the rightmost outlet, and the element value from the middle outlet.Each of these messages can be tested (synchronously or asynchronously) and the result of that test (a(failed) or a(passed)) returned to theobject's right inlet. When iteration is complete, and a result for each element has been sent to the object's right inlet, a(no elements passed the test) or a(some elements passed the test) will be sent from the object's left outlet.
